We need to produce a completed test class for getSectionRRsets method. Should include tests covering behavior: when section empty, returns empty list; when records present, groups by RRset (same name, type, class). Need to create Records: use Record.newRecord etc. Use ARecord, MXRecord etc. Use Section constants. Also test that sameRRset detection works: if multiple records with same name/type/class, they should be in same RRset.

We need to set up Message with records. Use Message.addRecord method (public). Add records to sections.

Test cases:

1. Empty section returns empty list.

2. Single record returns list size 1, RRset contains that record.

3. Multiple records same RRset: e.g., two A records for same name, same type/class. Expect list size 1, RRset has two records.

4. Multiple records different RRsets: e.g., A record and MX record for same name but different type => two RRsets.

Also test invalid section throws IllegalArgumentException via Section.check (internal). Section.check likely throws IllegalArgumentException for out of range. So test that.

Setup: no external dependencies; just use real classes.

We need imports: java.util.List; org.xbill.DNS.*; maybe java.net.InetAddress; java.net.UnknownHostException.

Use @BeforeEach to create a fresh Message instance.

Implement tests using JUnit5 assertions.

No need for Mockito.

Implement teardown nothing.
